title: Uniformly sublinear total influence
statement: A Boolean function class has uniformly sublinear total influence if there is a sequence $\eta_n\in[0,1]$ tending to zero such that, for every natural number $n$ and every function $f$ in the class at dimension $n$, the total influence of its real-valued version is at most $n\eta_n$.
hypotheses_covered: The total influence bound holds for every dimension and every class member
caveat: The upstream meanings of the real-valued version and total influence are not included.
